worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.summar: Restore half the health of one exact fainted party member, who stays in reserve. A nearby record of that individual's fall adds a beacon after success.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.0: Pray after an ally falls to bring a fainted party member back to half HP
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.1: Revive reserves far from where they fell
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.use.2: Light the matching death site after success
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.descri: Restore %2$s health to the first eligible fainted inactive party member. After success, a matching death record within %1$s blocks adds a beacon at that site.
The opening names the selected slot and individual. A changed slot refuses the attempt. Revival works regardless of the death-site distance, and the revived member stays in reserve.
Vigil: a wider clue search and longer beacon, purely a presentation preference with no wind-up or cooldown cost.
Short prayer: a narrower clue search and shorter beacon.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.timing: Death-site clue range: %1$s blocks. Prepare for %2$s s, recover for %3$s s, spend %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s. Party revival is independent of that range.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.growth: From level %1$s the death-site clue range reaches %2$s blocks.
From level %1$s the death-site clue range reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.revivalblessing.prefer: On: clue range ×1.25 and beacon ×1.35. Off: range ×0.85 and a shorter beacon. This only changes beacon presentation, never the selected member, wind-up or cooldown.
On: only prays over a fallen ally while facing a threat. Off (default): answers a fallen ally even out of combat.
